Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses DDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR PROCUREMENT OF MICROSOFT OFFICE 2024 S OFTWARE 1. Scope of Supply The vendor shall supply genuine and legally licensed Microsoft Office 2024 software for use on the comput ers of Military Hospital Lansdowne, as specified in the GeM bid. 2. Product Specification

The offered product shall be the exact Microsoft Office 2024 edition specified in the bid, such as Office Ho me & Business 2024 or another eligible edition selected by the purchaser. Any edition substitution shall re quire prior written approval from the purchaser. 3. Genuine Licensing The software shall be supplied through an authorised distribution channel with valid licensing rights. Pirate d, counterfeit, unauthorised, reused or improperly transferred licence keys shall not be accepted. 4. Licence Type The licence shall be of the type explicitly specified in the bid. The vendor shall clearly state whether it is a perpetual licence, subscription licence or another licensing arrangement. A subscription-based product sha ll not be supplied in place of a perpetual licence. 5. Compatibility The software shall be compatible with the operating system and hardware configuration of the hospital’s c omputers. Compatibility with the installed operating system shall be verified before installation. 6. Software Components The supplied edition shall include the applications and features specified in the bid. The vendor shall clearl y declare the included applications and any relevant licensing limitations. 7. Delivery and Activation The vendor shall provide the official download or installation method, genuine product key or other authori sed activation mechanism, and all required licence documentation. 8. Installation and Support Installation and activation assistance shall be provided wherever included in the bid. The vendor shall resolve activation and licensing issues attributable to the supplied product during the applicable support p eriod. 9. Documentation The vendor shall provide the product name, edition, licence type, quantity, licence validity or perpetual sta tus, proof of purchase or authorised supply, and relevant activation details. 10. Acceptance and Payment The software shall be accepted after verification of the product edition, licence authenticity, successful act ivation and compliance with the technical specifications. Payment shall be governed by the applicable con tract and GeM conditions. 11. Security and Compliance The software shall be genuine and supported through official channels. The vendor shall not supply unauth orised software or require disabling security controls to complete activation. 12. Non-Compliance Any product that does not meet the specified edition, licence type or technical requirements shall be dealt with in accordance with the contract and applicable procurement rules. 13. Pre-Bid Meeting reqd. .
